text.card: A star about 91 parsecs away, 1.6 times the Sun's width, measured by Gaia.
text.introduction: Gaia's parallax, brightness and spectrum give it 1.6 solar radii and 1.52 solar masses (FLAME) and 7,223 K at its surface (GSP-Phot).

quotes.title: Stella Ludoviciana
quotes.card: Stella Ludoviciana, also known as HD 116798, is an 8th-magnitude star in the asterism of the Big Dipper in the constellation Ursa Major, halfway between Mizar and Alcor.
quotes.introduction: A line-of-sight companion with Mizar and Alcor, it is roughly four times more distant.
